# Kapture

> Kapture is a free, local-first Chrome extension for screenshots, screen recording, annotation, and an on-device library. It does not require an account or upload captures.

Official site: https://trykapture.com/
Source code: https://github.com/Otitodev/kapture

## Useful pages

- Install from GitHub while the Chrome Web Store listing is under review: https://trykapture.com/docs/install/
- Capture modes and shortcuts: https://trykapture.com/docs/capture-modes/
- Privacy and local data handling: https://trykapture.com/docs/privacy/
- Changelog: https://trykapture.com/changelog/
